description.value:
A true second lung, not just augmented capacity.

Gift — Once per day, when reduced below half your maximum HP, take a breath as a free action and remove one of fatigued, sickened, or frightened (choose one). Tithe — Your breathing is loud and unmistakable under exertion: Stealth checks that would let you hold your breath silently instead take a −2 circumstance penalty while winded.

cinderfall.incomplete: The once-per-day reaction that removes fatigued, sickened, or frightened when dropping below half HP has no rule-element equivalent: it is a limited-use, player-choice-of-one-condition reaction, not a passive always-on effect, and granting it requires a new Reaction-type item (same class of gap as Loyal-Blood/Second-Skin).
